import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'state' and aggregate sums of numeric columns
df_grouped = df_union.groupby('state', as_index=False).agg({
    'missing_count': 'sum',
    'latitude': 'sum',
    'longitude': 'sum'
})

# Convert latitude and longitude to integer type as per target schema
df_grouped['missing_count'] = df_grouped['missing_count'].astype(int)
df_grouped['latitude'] = df_grouped['latitude'].astype(int)
df_grouped['longitude'] = df_grouped['longitude'].astype(int)

# Write the final output CSV with exact column names as target schema
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_38/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
